tasks.title: Align rating engines with 2025 Elo-like spec
tasks.description: Update both the Python reference script and TypeScript services so the Elo-like calculations match the PRD’s 2025 constants and formulas.
tasks.testStrategy: Expand `tests/unit/test-rating-calculation.test.ts` with fixtures covering provisional/established/elite players and every event tier; add cross-language parity test comparing outputs from `pool_elo.py` via snapshot CSV to the TS service. Run `npx jest` and CI lint.

tasks.title: Persist detailed rating events in PostgreSQL
tasks.description: Introduce a normalized schema to store per-match rating deltas, factors, and audit data required for transparency.
tasks.details:
Create migration adding `player_rating_events` with fields: id, player_id FK, match_id FK, rating_before, rating_after, rating_change, expected_score, observed_score, blended_score, k_factor, race_factor, tier_multiplier, field_multiplier, margin_factor, balls_factor, created_at. Add supporting table `rating_event_factors` if optional features (balls-made) need separate storage. Update `scripts/import-ratings.ts` and `src/lib/db/import-python-ratings.ts` to read `pool_ratings_report.csv` from the Python run and batch insert rows inside a transaction. Extend `src/lib/db/database-service.ts` with helper methods `recordRatingEvents` and `getRatingEventsByPlayer`. Pseudo-code for import:
```
for row in csv:
  await client.query('INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE', mapCsv(row))
```
Ensure indexes on `player_id`, `match_id`, and `created_at` for fast history queries.
tasks.testStrategy: Add integration tests under `tests/integration` using a temporary database to run the migration, import a small CSV, and assert persisted rows. Include contract tests ensuring the schema enforces FK and numeric ranges (e.g., rating_change within +/-200).

tasks.title: Expose rating transparency APIs and exports

tasks.testStrategy: Write contract tests in `tests/contract/test-get-player-rating-events.test.ts` to verify pagination, filtering, and HTTP 403 for unauthorized exports. Add performance guard ensuring 50 events return under 200ms using mocked DB client.

tasks.testStrategy: Add React Testing Library tests to confirm factors render when events exist, skeleton states appear when loading, and download button calls correct endpoint. Include visual regression snapshot for the rating timeline. Run `npx jest`.
